final.optionAnalysis.d.reason: Overstates the independence. The measures come in two pairs: M-squared is a monotonic transformation of Sharpe, so that pair always ranks identically, and Jensen's alpha and Treynor share the systematic-risk charge and always agree in sign ($T^2 = \alpha_p/\beta_p$).
